purpose: Separately declared G1024 budget sufficiency development probe after G512 remained below95%; original science/scoring/candidates/return guards preserved.
optional_existing_ablation: Only G is declared in this budget study; no alternative methods are auto-run

environment.start: Unchanged generator start projection in a fixed 1m neighborhood; single initial rendered frame, no exploratory prefix

policy.capability_note: Legacy flags select CPU module interfaces; actual recorded capabilities are authoritative. No trained reachability network or open-vocabulary detector is being evaluated.

sensor_adapter.name: visible_semantic_dictionary_v1
sensor_adapter.source_dictionary: VirtualWorldV2 class 2 = solid box, class 3 = open shelf (env/virtual3d_v2.py lines 59-73)
sensor_adapter.policy_dictionary: v10 competition prior class 2 = open, class 3 = closed (nso/competition_prior_v8.py lines 35-48; cpu_four_modules_v10.py lines 189-204)
sensor_adapter.applied_to: Currently visible label pixels returned by renderer only; invalid depth labels stay zero
sensor_adapter.semantic_information: Ideal synthetic visible labels, not RGB marker detection; no hidden object labels, mesh or reachable map passed to actor
sensor_adapter.odometry: Exact simulated centred discrete base/camera pose

evaluation.coverage: Known cells intersected with simulator start-reachable free-cell mask; truth used only after policy action for evaluation
primary: per-plan feasibility, return cost and coverage scores
evaluation.surface: Measured mapper patch count only in this pilot; not surface area, F1, map accuracy or completeness
evaluation.deferred: Exterior-union reference and TSDF P/R/F1 evaluation; robust semantic controls and frontier; larger matched budget adequacy
evaluation.outcomes: All attempts retained; no replacement of failed slots or result-based layout tuning
evaluation.independence: G/S are paired trajectories in one new generated layout, not two independent scenes

execution.hardware: None; no ROS imports or launchers
execution.recording: Compact initial sensor, evaluation map, decisions, steps and results; no videos/rosbags/full-frame sequences
